title: ProviderTicket
description: An entry in the kubemoot_provider_tickets bucket. A ticket (key <provider>__<ticketId>) claims a slot and memory on a provider for one model call and is deleted when the call ends. A residency entry (key residency__<provider>__<model>) records a model left loaded on a provider; in its key the provider and model names keep letters, digits and '-', and write any other character as '_' and two hex digits ('__' and four above U+00FF), so qwen3:14b becomes qwen3_3a14b. The modelName field holds the name itself.

modelName.description: The model. Always on residency entries.

modelFootprintMiB.description: Memory the model takes, in MiB.

kvCacheFootprintMiB.description: Memory the call's KV cache takes, in MiB. Tickets only.

holderId.description: The pod holding the ticket. Tickets only.

claimedAt.description: When the ticket was claimed, RFC 3339 in UTC. Tickets only.

evicts.description: Models the call unloads to make room, with the MiB each frees.
